description: A project's register of persons — the people its texts name — each with their spellings by script and form, each spelling's source and whether it is checked (see find_person), facts (born, died, wikidata, mathGenealogy, orcid, mrAuthor) the same way, and the project's note on why they are here. 'state' is 'confirmed', 'proposed' (found in the texts, waiting for a person — set_person with state decides it) or 'rejected'; proposed and rejected ones only to members who may write. 'reading' says whether the project has its texts read for persons. 'q' narrows to persons with a spelling holding those words. To a member who may write, 'similar' pairs two persons that look like one, with the two spellings and why — 'form' (the same up to the form of the words, «Гупта» / «Гупты»), 'letter' (one letter apart in a long Latin name, «Sjogren» / «Sjorgren»), 'transliteration' («Сьёгрен» / «Sjogren») or 'initials' («N. D. Gupta» / «Narayan D. Gupta») — a hint for the person to decide, never a fact: merge_persons only when they agree, distinct_persons when they say the two are different people — 'distinct' lists those answers. 'merged' lists the persons merged into one, whose spellings and facts are shown among its own with 'mergedFrom'. Only spellings whose source you may open; a person none of whose spellings you may see is not listed. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 200. Default 100.

offset.description: How many to skip — for the next page.

onlyUnchecked.description: true for only persons with a spelling or fact that is not checked — written from memory or no longer in its source.

q.description: Words a spelling holds, case aside.

source.description: Only persons read from this source: 'page:471', 'issue:KYC-12', 'comment:88', 'wikicomment:7', or 'none' for those written with no source. 'sources' in the answer lists them with counts.

state.description: 'confirmed', 'proposed', 'rejected' or leave out for all you may see.
